Team NEXORA🚀

We are Team NEXORA, a group of passionate innovators interested in technology, space exploration, AI, and creative problem-solving. We aim to turn innovative ideas into real-world solutions through teamwork, creativity, and learning.

We welcome enthusiastic members who want to explore, innovate, and make an impact.

Looking for: Programmers, AI/ML enthusiasts, web developers, UI/UX designers, researchers, and creative thinkers.

Think Beyond. Innovate Beyond. Explore Beyond! 🚀
